name: vtc-group
description: A community group's own identity (vtc/groups/create). The community's VTA mints and holds it; the community never does. The group's DID issues its members' membership credentials, under an authorization credential the community issues it, so a verifier chains member → group → community. The document carries a signing key (assertion and authentication) and a key-agreement key, and nothing else: no service, because nothing delivers messages to a group yet (group messaging adds one by a DID update), and no name, description or label, so resolving the DID reveals nothing about the group. did:webvh rather than did:peer, so the group's keys can rotate and a DID update can add a service. WITNESSES is recommended where the DID host is not fully trusted.
